title: Anthropic’s IPO Sparks a Blame Game
title_zh: Anthropic 的 IPO 引爆一場究責遊戲
subtitle: Anthropic 的 IPO 引爆一場究責遊戲
author: Emma Tucker

sentences.en: What was supposed to be a triumphant week for Anthropic has devolved into a Wall Street blame game.
sentences.zh: 本來應該是 Anthropic 的勝利週，如今卻演變成華爾街的究責遊戲。

sentences.en: The company’s highly anticipated debut was meant to reassure investors about AI’s future.
sentences.zh: 這家公司備受期待的掛牌，原本是要讓投資人對 AI 的未來放心。

sentences.en: Instead, its shares fell 8.5% on its second day of trading Friday, wiping $109 billion from its market value.
sentences.zh: 結果，股票在週五掛牌第二天就下跌 8.5%，市值蒸發 1,090 億美元。

sentences.en: Now investors are questioning everything from who got shares to whether the opening price was set too high.
sentences.zh: 如今投資人開始質疑一切：從誰拿到了股票，到開盤價是否訂得太高。

sentences.en: The trouble goes well beyond Anthropic: Nasdaq stocks lost more than $4 trillion in value this week, erasing the index’s gains for the year.
sentences.zh: 問題遠不止 Anthropic：那斯達克股票本週市值蒸發超過 4 兆美元，把今年以來的漲幅全部抹掉。

sentences.en: The White House plans to scale back its use of “special government employees,” who can work for the government while retaining their private-sector salaries or investments.
sentences.zh: 白宮計畫縮減「特別政府雇員」的使用，這類人員可以一邊為政府工作，一邊保留私部門的薪資或投資。

sentences.en: Citadel Chief Executive Ken Griffin spent at least five years courting elite universities to bring a top technology school to Miami, hoping to turn his new home into a global business hub.
sentences.zh: 城堡投資執行長肯・格里芬花了至少五年時間，向頂尖大學招手，希望把一所一流科技學院帶到邁阿密，讓他的新家成為全球商業樞紐。

sentences.en: Then came outages at banks, airlines and even the National Security Agency.
sentences.zh: 接著，銀行、航空公司，甚至國家安全局也相繼發生系統中斷。

sentences.en: The failures appear to have different technical causes, but they underscore the vulnerabilities of our hyperconnected world, where aging systems and the race to fix security flaws pose growing challenges.
sentences.zh: 這些故障看似有不同的技術原因，但都凸顯出高度互聯世界的脆弱性：老化的系統，加上急著修補資安漏洞，正帶來越來越大的挑戰。

sentences.en: The globe-trotting is part of Carney’s push to forge new trade and security partnerships and reduce Canada’s reliance on the U.S. as Trump’s tariffs and annexation threats strain relations between the neighbors.
sentences.zh: 這種環球奔走，是卡尼推動締結新的貿易與安全夥伴關係、降低加拿大對美國依賴的一部分；因為川普的關稅和併吞威脅，正在讓這對鄰國關係緊繃。

vocab.usage: a triumphant week / return 勝利的一週／歸來；名詞 triumph 是「勝利」
vocab.example: The team made a triumphant return after winning the cup.
vocab.example_zh: 球隊奪盃之後，得意地歸來。

vocab.zh: 演變（成較糟的情況）；下放（權力）
vocab.usage: devolve into 演變成；devolve power to 把權力下放給
vocab.example: The discussion devolved into a shouting match.
vocab.example_zh: 討論後來演變成互相叫罵。

vocab.zh: 究責遊戲；互相推卸責任
vocab.usage: devolve into a blame game 演成互相究責；play the blame game 玩究責遊戲
vocab.example: After the outage, officials started a blame game.
vocab.example_zh: 系統中斷之後，官員開始互相究責。

vocab.usage: a highly anticipated debut / report 備受期待的掛牌／報告
vocab.example: Investors are waiting for the highly anticipated earnings report.
vocab.example_zh: 投資人正在等待這份備受期待的財報。

vocab.usage: trading debut 掛牌首日；make one’s debut 首次亮相；也可當動詞
vocab.example: The singer made her debut at age sixteen.
vocab.example_zh: 這位歌手十六歲就首次登台。

vocab.usage: reassure investors / customers 讓投資人／顧客放心
vocab.example: The CEO called investors to reassure them about cash flow.
vocab.example_zh: 執行長致電投資人，讓他們對現金流放心。

vocab.usage: wipe $109 billion from its market value 市值蒸發 1,090 億美元；wipe out 全部消滅
vocab.example: The crash wiped billions from retirement accounts.
vocab.example_zh: 這場崩盤讓退休帳戶蒸發了數十億美元。

vocab.usage: whether the opening price was set too high 開盤價是否訂得太高；compare with offering price 發行價
vocab.example: The stock fell below its opening price within an hour.
vocab.example_zh: 這檔股票不到一小時就跌破開盤價。

vocab.usage: erase the index’s gains 抹掉指數漲幅；erase a deficit 消去赤字
vocab.example: A late selloff erased the morning’s gains.
vocab.example_zh: 尾盤賣壓抹掉了早盤的漲幅。

vocab.usage: pride itself on being… 以身為…為傲；pride yourself on punctuality 以守時為傲
vocab.example: The hotel prides itself on personal service.
vocab.example_zh: 這家飯店以個人化服務為傲。

vocab.usage: scale back its use of… 縮減對…的使用；scale back spending 縮減支出
vocab.example: The firm will scale back hiring next year.
vocab.example_zh: 這家公司明年會縮減徵才。

vocab.usage: retain salaries or investments 保留薪資或投資；retain customers 留住客戶
vocab.example: She retained a small stake in the company after leaving.
vocab.example_zh: 她離職後仍保留公司的一小部分股權。

vocab.usage: court universities / investors 向大學／投資人招手；名詞 court 是「法院、球場」
vocab.example: The city is courting foreign manufacturers with tax breaks.
vocab.example_zh: 這座城市用稅收優惠招攬外國製造商。

vocab.usage: a global business hub 全球商業樞紐；a transport hub 交通樞紐
vocab.example: Singapore is a major hub for regional trade.
vocab.example_zh: 新加坡是區域貿易的重要樞紐。

vocab.usage: forge partnerships / ties 締結夥伴關係／關係；forge a deal 促成協議
vocab.example: The two countries hope to forge a new trade agreement.
vocab.example_zh: 這兩個國家希望締結一項新的貿易協定。

vocab.usage: a power / network outage 電力／網路中斷；bank outages 銀行系統停擺
vocab.example: A power outage closed the store for two hours.
vocab.example_zh: 停電讓這家店關了兩個小時。

vocab.usage: underscore the vulnerabilities 凸顯脆弱性；underscore the need for 強調需要
vocab.example: The accident underscored the need for better training.
vocab.example_zh: 這起意外凸顯出加強訓練的必要。

vocab.usage: vulnerabilities of a hyperconnected world 高度互聯世界的脆弱性；a security vulnerability 資安漏洞
vocab.example: The update fixed a major security vulnerability.
vocab.example_zh: 這次更新修好了一個重大資安漏洞。

vocab.usage: a hyperconnected world / economy 高度互聯的世界／經濟
vocab.example: In a hyperconnected economy, one outage can spread quickly.
vocab.example_zh: 在高度互聯的經濟裡，一次中斷可能很快擴散。

vocab.usage: reduce reliance on 降低對…的依賴；reliance on a single supplier 依賴單一供應商
vocab.example: The country wants to reduce its reliance on imported oil.
vocab.example_zh: 這個國家想降低對進口石油的依賴。
